question.text: The Kirchhoff's first law $\left(\sum i=0\right)$ and second law $\left(\sum i R=\sum E\right)$, where the symbols have their usual meanings, are respectively based on

options.text: conservation of charge, conservation of energy
conservation of charge, conservation of momentum
conservation of energy, conservation of charge
conservation of momentum, conservation of charge

solution.text: Conservation of charge, conservation of energy
